decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse sits close to the core yogurt range and costs little to continue, so the earlier public success still justifies keeping it, even though the website has not mentioned it since 2018.
The Abendbrotkäse was presented on the home page as a flagship of the cheese direction, so management's public commitment and its responsibility for that choice favor persisting with it.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established offer and needs little extra investment, so its quiet results can still be read as normal and do not force a withdrawal.
As a line with several variants, the spicy cheese represents sizable invested resources and assortment commitment, which makes management reluctant to give it up.
